about: Corrections to the catalog's titles, by hand, keyed by archive.org identifier: each a title and the reason for it. Applied last, over the title chosen from the program (scripts/catalog/titles.mjs); its titleSource is then "correction". The design is kb/guides/compatibility.md, "Titles".

win3_PATUMAN.title: The Patuman
win3_PATUMAN.reason: Its caption, the only candidate, runs on into the game's state: "The Patuman (v.) inertial moment is 4. Press SPACE to play". The name is its first two words.

win3_stat.title: Statline
win3_stat.reason: Its caption is a message, "From Statline... It's 9 am"; its module description is "Statline", the name the message gives.
